symptom: A snippet contentparam `"Mod"."Product"/System.changedBy/System.User/Name` passed check and exec and made mxbuild abort the build ("An error occurred when trying to set the 'Attribute' property"); run --local could not boot.
cause: resolveAssociationPathFrom read the leading entity step as an association, failed, and the caller wrote the whole string as one flat Attribute. The fully qualified association forms in the report (quoted Mod.Assoc/Mod.Entity/Attr in columns and params) already resolve on main since #2127.
fix: A leading step naming the start entity or a generalization of it, and no association, is dropped; the path then stores exactly like the short form (verified: identical Association/Attribute, mx check clean on 11.12.6).
insight: Re-run the report on main before fixing: two of its three shapes were already fixed, and only the leading-entity shape remained. The flat-path fallback is the dangerous part — any unresolved `/` path is written verbatim and can abort mxbuild rather than raise a CE.
